name: DeploymentSettings
title: Blocks/Account/DeploymentSettings
summary: The account's Build and deployment settings. A `PageHeader` with Documentation and the primary Create Deployment Setting, a closable info `Alert` that explains what a Deployment Setting is, then three `SettingsSection`s. New service defaults: a flush `Card` of `SettingsRow`s in an `Item.List` with a binding policy `Select`, a deployment policy `Select` and an Apply to existing `Switch`, saved through a `SaveBar` that appears only with unsaved changes (Discard, Save). All services: a collapsible `Accordion` whose trigger counts the services and tags how many share a setting; inside, a search `Input` (a small `EmptyState` with Clear search when nothing matches) and, ten services per page with `Pagination`, one row per environment with environment and policy `Tag`s, a `Select` that rebinds it to a matching Deployment Setting (inactive ones disabled), and Linked automatically and Shared `Tag`s; a rebind ends in a toast that warns when the setting now reaches several services. Deployment Settings: the table-view controls row (`PropertyFilter`, Refresh and Download CSV as `IconButton`s with a `Tooltip`, `CollectionPreferences`) over a `Table` on one `useCollection` (Name with a System `Tag` for Default, Services with a Shared `Tag` and the service names on a `Tooltip`, Type hidden by default, Binding policy, Deployment policy, `Table.CellStatus`, `Table.CellTime` for Last modified, `Table.CellActions` with Edit, Clone and Delete behind a `ConfirmDialog`). Create and Edit open a large `Drawer` form (Name, Description, Active `Switch`, binding and deployment policy `RadioGroup`s). Loading draws `Skeleton`s; no services draws an `EmptyState`. Its toasts go through `toast` into the app's one toast region. A page body for ConsoleLayout, rendered in its default slot.

variants.name: UnsavedChanges
variants.summary: The binding policy default changed from Strict to Flexible: the SaveBar says You have unsaved changes. with Discard and Save; Save confirms with a toast and Discard puts the saved value back.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: An account with no service yet: All services shows a small EmptyState and the Deployment Settings table holds only Default.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first load: Skeletons in place of the default Selects and the services, and the table's loading rows.
